trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The author pretends to show that opening prices are arbitrary.
trap.right: The author aims to show that opening prices are arbitrary.
trap.why: Em português “pretende mostrar” = quer/tem intenção. Em inglês, pretend significa fingir. Use aim/intend/seek.

mcq.q: Main idea: “The author ___ that anchors bias us.”

fix.wrong: The author argue that the number is arbitrary.
fix.right: The author argues that the number is arbitrary.

fix.wrong: The text pretends to explain bias.
fix.right: The text intends to explain bias.

fix.wrong: One study showed that the first number it affects price.
fix.right: One study showed that the first number affects price.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com argues: “The author thinks anchors matter.” (argues that)
rewrite.answer: The author argues that anchors matter.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com aims to: “The author pretends to explain bias.” (aims)
rewrite.answer: The author aims to explain bias.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Overall: “In conclusion, the text suggests a bias.”
rewrite.answer: Overall, the text suggests a bias.
